meta.title: Heresy's Birth
meta.description: The hand holds the sword of dawn; the eye holds the serpent's promised fruit.

units.rawText: Shortly after the teams first split up.
units.displayText: Shortly after the teams first split up.

spans.text: Shortly after the teams first split up.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Eosphorus and Eos speed through the labyrinth, their faces calm, as though they were in Sanctifier-held territory and not in the lair of their old enemy, with danger lurking around every corner.
units.displayText: Eosphorus and Eos speed through the labyrinth, their faces calm, as though they were in Sanctifier-held territory and not in the lair of their old enemy, with danger lurking around every corner.

spans.text: Eosphorus and Eos speed through the labyrinth, their faces calm, as though they were in Sanctifier-held territory and not in the lair of their old enemy, with danger lurking around every corner.

units.rawText: All manner of bizarre-looking Entropics pass them, but there is no reaction. The Spoof Code cloaks the two of them and their actions perfectly, to the point where the Entropic horde doesn't even realize they're there.
units.displayText: All manner of bizarre-looking Entropics pass them, but there is no reaction. The Spoof Code cloaks the two of them and their actions perfectly, to the point where the Entropic horde doesn't even realize they're there.

spans.text: All manner of bizarre-looking Entropics pass them, but there is no reaction. The Spoof Code cloaks the two of them and their actions perfectly, to the point where the Entropic horde doesn't even realize they're there.

units.rawText: We're almost at the indicated coordinates, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: We're almost at the indicated coordinates, Eosphorus.

spans.text: We're almost at the indicated coordinates, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Eosphorus?

spans.text: Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Ah... yes, I understand.
units.displayText: Ah... yes, I understand.

spans.text: Ah... yes, I understand.

units.rawText: Pffft, are you actually distracted? And you were going on about this just now—
units.displayText: Pffft, are you actually distracted? And you were going on about this just now—

spans.text: Pffft, are you actually distracted? And you were going on about this just now—

units.rawText: "While the movements of the Outer Ring are largely within our expectations, we might end up facing unknown entities and situations going forward."
units.displayText: "While the movements of the Outer Ring are largely within our expectations, we might end up facing unknown entities and situations going forward."

spans.text: "While the movements of the Outer Ring are largely within our expectations, we might end up facing unknown entities and situations going forward."

units.rawText: Stay alert, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Stay alert, Eosphorus.

spans.text: Stay alert, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Did I get the tone right? I even tried to replicate the pauses in your speech.
units.displayText: Did I get the tone right? I even tried to replicate the pauses in your speech.

spans.text: Did I get the tone right? I even tried to replicate the pauses in your speech.

units.rawText: Oh you...
units.displayText: Oh you...

spans.text: Oh you...

units.rawText: It's only because I know you're here that I'm relaxed enough to consider other things. Then you turn around and tease me instead.
units.displayText: It's only because I know you're here that I'm relaxed enough to consider other things. Then you turn around and tease me instead.

spans.text: It's only because I know you're here that I'm relaxed enough to consider other things. Then you turn around and tease me instead.

units.rawText: Hehe, well, I don't see you like that often, after all. Actually, I did a little asking around about what everyone thinks of you.
units.displayText: Hehe, well, I don't see you like that often, after all. Actually, I did a little asking around about what everyone thinks of you.

spans.text: Hehe, well, I don't see you like that often, after all. Actually, I did a little asking around about what everyone thinks of you.

units.rawText: Most people praised you in various ways, but one person was a little different.
units.displayText: Most people praised you in various ways, but one person was a little different.

spans.text: Most people praised you in various ways, but one person was a little different.

units.rawText: Eos seems to be recalling something, because she covers her mouth and smiles before clearing her throat.
units.displayText: Eos seems to be recalling something, because she covers her mouth and smiles before clearing her throat.

spans.text: Eos seems to be recalling something, because she covers her mouth and smiles before clearing her throat.

units.rawText: Ahem...
units.displayText: Ahem...

spans.text: Ahem...

units.rawText: "Yes, indeed, well done, so that's how it is, understood, relax, I will, don't worry."
units.displayText: "Yes, indeed, well done, so that's how it is, understood, relax, I will, don't worry."

spans.text: "Yes, indeed, well done, so that's how it is, understood, relax, I will, don't worry."

units.rawText: Eosphorus uses many such phrases but there is hardly any change in his tonal inflection, which indicates he doesn't spend time on verbal showmanship. That makes him quite a reliable leader.
units.displayText: Eosphorus uses many such phrases but there is hardly any change in his tonal inflection, which indicates he doesn't spend time on verbal showmanship. That makes him quite a reliable leader.

spans.text: Eosphorus uses many such phrases but there is hardly any change in his tonal inflection, which indicates he doesn't spend time on verbal showmanship. That makes him quite a reliable leader.

units.rawText: ...<cmdr> has always analyzed questions in a special way.
units.displayText: ...{교수} has always analyzed questions in a special way.

spans.text: has always analyzed questions in a special way.

units.rawText: "He's" quite special to everyone.
units.displayText: "He's" quite special to everyone.

spans.text: "He's" quite special to everyone.

units.rawText: Whenever everyone else complained about how unapproachable you were, <cmdr> was always the one who smoothed things over.
units.displayText: Whenever everyone else complained about how unapproachable you were, {교수} was always the one who smoothed things over.

spans.text: Whenever everyone else complained about how unapproachable you were,
was always the one who smoothed things over.

units.rawText: Please stop taking shots at me. I do have to take responsibility for the Sanctifiers under my command.
units.displayText: Please stop taking shots at me. I do have to take responsibility for the Sanctifiers under my command.

spans.text: Please stop taking shots at me. I do have to take responsibility for the Sanctifiers under my command.

units.rawText: In a rare display, Eosphorus sighs.
units.displayText: In a rare display, Eosphorus sighs.

spans.text: In a rare display, Eosphorus sighs.

units.rawText: Even if the operation isn't particularly risky in itself, I still need to put on a show of carefulness and formality so they will carry out their tasks properly.
units.displayText: Even if the operation isn't particularly risky in itself, I still need to put on a show of carefulness and formality so they will carry out their tasks properly.

spans.text: Even if the operation isn't particularly risky in itself, I still need to put on a show of carefulness and formality so they will carry out their tasks properly.

units.rawText: Then, pray tell, what was our careful and formal Lord Eosphorus contemplating just now? To the point of distraction, even?
units.displayText: Then, pray tell, what was our careful and formal Lord Eosphorus contemplating just now? To the point of distraction, even?

spans.text: Then, pray tell, what was our careful and formal Lord Eosphorus contemplating just now? To the point of distraction, even?

units.rawText: I was thinking about the holy relic. I hope it did not fall in an area with a dense concentration of Entropics. That way, recovery will be easier for us.
units.displayText: I was thinking about the holy relic. I hope it did not fall in an area with a dense concentration of Entropics. That way, recovery will be easier for us.

spans.text: I was thinking about the holy relic. I hope it did not fall in an area with a dense concentration of Entropics. That way, recovery will be easier for us.

units.rawText: Is that all?
units.displayText: Is that all?

spans.text: Is that all?

units.rawText: ...I hope we can complete the recovery work quickly and easily and meet up with the others ASAP. <cmdr> isn't in good shape, and it worries me. Alcyone's lack of experience is also a cause for concern.
units.displayText: ...I hope we can complete the recovery work quickly and easily and meet up with the others ASAP. {교수} isn't in good shape, and it worries me. Alcyone's lack of experience is also a cause for concern.

spans.text: ...I hope we can complete the recovery work quickly and easily and meet up with the others ASAP.
isn't in good shape, and it worries me. Alcyone's lack of experience is also a cause for concern.

units.rawText: Hehe, now we're getting somewhere. Relax; like you said, this is the Outer Ring and we won't encounter any troublesome surprises.
units.displayText: Hehe, now we're getting somewhere. Relax; like you said, this is the Outer Ring and we won't encounter any troublesome surprises.

spans.text: Hehe, now we're getting somewhere. Relax; like you said, this is the Outer Ring and we won't encounter any troublesome surprises.

units.rawText: Perhaps, but we still need to maintain a degree of strategic caution. Otherwise, if we rouse Malkira...
units.displayText: Perhaps, but we still need to maintain a degree of strategic caution. Otherwise, if we rouse Malkira...

spans.text: Perhaps, but we still need to maintain a degree of strategic caution. Otherwise, if we rouse Malkira...

units.rawText: No, even alerting the other High-Order Entropics would not be good. We cannot let the Tartarus Sector awaken so soon.
units.displayText: No, even alerting the other High-Order Entropics would not be good. We cannot let the Tartarus Sector awaken so soon.

spans.text: No, even alerting the other High-Order Entropics would not be good. We cannot let the Tartarus Sector awaken so soon.

units.rawText: Upon discussing serious business, Eos' playful attitude vanishes and she strokes her chin in thought.
units.displayText: Upon discussing serious business, Eos' playful attitude vanishes and she strokes her chin in thought.

spans.text: Upon discussing serious business, Eos' playful attitude vanishes and she strokes her chin in thought.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, I still don't understand why there's a holy relic in the Outer Ring of Tartarus.
units.displayText: Speaking of which, I still don't understand why there's a holy relic in the Outer Ring of Tartarus.

spans.text: Speaking of which, I still don't understand why there's a holy relic in the Outer Ring of Tartarus.

units.rawText: If someone told me one day that a divine weapon that killed Sanctifiers had landed in the vicinity of the Reverse Tower, I would classify them as an Irregular Agent and cleanse them once I had verified that judgment.
units.displayText: If someone told me one day that a divine weapon that killed Sanctifiers had landed in the vicinity of the Reverse Tower, I would classify them as an Irregular Agent and cleanse them once I had verified that judgment.

spans.text: If someone told me one day that a divine weapon that killed Sanctifiers had landed in the vicinity of the Reverse Tower, I would classify them as an Irregular Agent and cleanse them once I had verified that judgment.

units.rawText: In truth, the news came from the Chamber of Holy Discourse, revealed to us by the gods. Ever since the Great Silence, we have not received Their revelations for a long time now.
units.displayText: In truth, the news came from the Chamber of Holy Discourse, revealed to us by the gods. Ever since the Great Silence, we have not received Their revelations for a long time now.

spans.text: In truth, the news came from the Chamber of Holy Discourse, revealed to us by the gods. Ever since the Great Silence, we have not received Their revelations for a long time now.

units.rawText: The gods move in mysterious ways and the voice of the gods comes upon us suddenly. All we can do is carry out Their will.
units.displayText: The gods move in mysterious ways and the voice of the gods comes upon us suddenly. All we can do is carry out Their will.

spans.text: The gods move in mysterious ways and the voice of the gods comes upon us suddenly. All we can do is carry out Their will.

units.rawText: I would not be surprised if They could overturn the Tartarus Sector in a night with Their power.
units.displayText: I would not be surprised if They could overturn the Tartarus Sector in a night with Their power.

spans.text: I would not be surprised if They could overturn the Tartarus Sector in a night with Their power.

units.rawText: Eos opens her mouth but hesitates to speak. Then she shakes her head before closing her eyes and putting her hands together in front of her chest.
units.displayText: Eos opens her mouth but hesitates to speak. Then she shakes her head before closing her eyes and putting her hands together in front of her chest.

spans.text: Eos opens her mouth but hesitates to speak. Then she shakes her head before closing her eyes and putting her hands together in front of her chest.

units.rawText: May the gods forgive my ignorant foolery and shallow doubts.
units.displayText: May the gods forgive my ignorant foolery and shallow doubts.

spans.text: May the gods forgive my ignorant foolery and shallow doubts.

units.rawText: There is no telling whether it was coincidental or deliberate, but the moment Eos finishes speaking, the memory block within Eosphorus that is reserved for storing divine pronouncements activates.
units.displayText: There is no telling whether it was coincidental or deliberate, but the moment Eos finishes speaking, the memory block within Eosphorus that is reserved for storing divine pronouncements activates.

spans.text: There is no telling whether it was coincidental or deliberate, but the moment Eos finishes speaking, the memory block within Eosphorus that is reserved for storing divine pronouncements activates.

units.rawText: A section of code that is dramatically different from previous commands suddenly pops out, like a young beast that has scented prey or like a traveler that heard a call.
units.displayText: A section of code that is dramatically different from previous commands suddenly pops out, like a young beast that has scented prey or like a traveler that heard a call.

spans.text: A section of code that is dramatically different from previous commands suddenly pops out, like a young beast that has scented prey or like a traveler that heard a call.

units.rawText: What's wrong?
units.displayText: What's wrong?

spans.text: What's wrong?

units.rawText: The guidance of the pronouncements is clarifying itself. We must make haste.
units.displayText: The guidance of the pronouncements is clarifying itself. We must make haste.

spans.text: The guidance of the pronouncements is clarifying itself. We must make haste.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Soon, Eosphorus and Eos have followed the guidance program of the pronouncements to their destination.
units.displayText: Soon, Eosphorus and Eos have followed the guidance program of the pronouncements to their destination.

spans.text: Soon, Eosphorus and Eos have followed the guidance program of the pronouncements to their destination.

units.rawText: It is a deep cave. A longsword is planted in its midst, like a museum exhibit, resting with incongruous serenity amidst danger.
units.displayText: It is a deep cave. A longsword is planted in its midst, like a museum exhibit, resting with incongruous serenity amidst danger.

spans.text: It is a deep cave. A longsword is planted in its midst, like a museum exhibit, resting with incongruous serenity amidst danger.

units.rawText: The longsword's surface is smeared by mud, looking at once like binding chains and a prayerful offering. There are only a few Low-Order Entropics nearby.
units.displayText: The longsword's surface is smeared by mud, looking at once like binding chains and a prayerful offering. There are only a few Low-Order Entropics nearby.

spans.text: The longsword's surface is smeared by mud, looking at once like binding chains and a prayerful offering. There are only a few Low-Order Entropics nearby.

units.rawText: Your prayers have been answered. There are no problems here.
units.displayText: Your prayers have been answered. There are no problems here.

spans.text: Your prayers have been answered. There are no problems here.

units.rawText: Is that the relic? It seems very ordinary. I sense no operands sleeping within it or any other way in which it is special.
units.displayText: Is that the relic? It seems very ordinary. I sense no operands sleeping within it or any other way in which it is special.

spans.text: Is that the relic? It seems very ordinary. I sense no operands sleeping within it or any other way in which it is special.

units.rawText: It matches the news conveyed from the revelations. There is no mistake.
units.displayText: It matches the news conveyed from the revelations. There is no mistake.

spans.text: It matches the news conveyed from the revelations. There is no mistake.

units.rawText: Eosphorus nods to Eos and approaches the longsword.
units.displayText: Eosphorus nods to Eos and approaches the longsword.

spans.text: Eosphorus nods to Eos and approaches the longsword.

units.rawText: Skree!
units.displayText: Skree!

spans.text: Skree!

units.rawText: The wandering monsters sense something and turn to face their enemy. Eos does not immediately strike them down; instead, she places her finger over her lips, as though to ask a favor of them.
units.displayText: The wandering monsters sense something and turn to face their enemy. Eos does not immediately strike them down; instead, she places her finger over her lips, as though to ask a favor of them.

spans.text: The wandering monsters sense something and turn to face their enemy. Eos does not immediately strike them down; instead, she places her finger over her lips, as though to ask a favor of them.

units.rawText: Shhh—
units.displayText: Shhh—

spans.text: Shhh—

units.rawText: Don't make too much noise, okay?
units.displayText: Don't make too much noise, okay?

spans.text: Don't make too much noise, okay?

units.rawText: Could you please leave for now? We need some time alone.
units.displayText: Could you please leave for now? We need some time alone.

spans.text: Could you please leave for now? We need some time alone.

units.rawText: Skree...
units.displayText: Skree...

spans.text: Skree...

units.rawText: The utterly incompatible and alien entities accept Eos' suggestion and nonchalantly depart.
units.displayText: The utterly incompatible and alien entities accept Eos' suggestion and nonchalantly depart.

spans.text: The utterly incompatible and alien entities accept Eos' suggestion and nonchalantly depart.

units.rawText: What good kids they are.
units.displayText: What good kids they are.

spans.text: What good kids they are.

units.rawText: Your domination programs are quite elegant. Could you explain them to me?
units.displayText: Your domination programs are quite elegant. Could you explain them to me?

spans.text: Your domination programs are quite elegant. Could you explain them to me?

units.rawText: A crisp clear voice fills their ears and their response is a pair of swift attacks.
units.displayText: A crisp clear voice fills their ears and their response is a pair of swift attacks.

spans.text: A crisp clear voice fills their ears and their response is a pair of swift attacks.

units.rawText: Thunk—
units.displayText: Thunk—

spans.text: Thunk—

units.rawText: There is a sensation of a solid hit. The source of the voice crumbles but Eos and Eosphorus stay on their guard.
units.displayText: There is a sensation of a solid hit. The source of the voice crumbles but Eos and Eosphorus stay on their guard.

spans.text: There is a sensation of a solid hit. The source of the voice crumbles but Eos and Eosphorus stay on their guard.

units.rawText: Unlike the rest of the repulsive Entropic creations, a figure wreathed in a pleasant pale blue light emerges from the shadows in another direction, proudly revealing itself to the two of them.
units.displayText: Unlike the rest of the repulsive Entropic creations, a figure wreathed in a pleasant pale blue light emerges from the shadows in another direction, proudly revealing itself to the two of them.

spans.text: Unlike the rest of the repulsive Entropic creations, a figure wreathed in a pleasant pale blue light emerges from the shadows in another direction, proudly revealing itself to the two of them.

units.rawText: Oh my, is this how Greater Sanctifiers greet people? How boorish; do you act this way when visiting other sectors?
units.displayText: Oh my, is this how Greater Sanctifiers greet people? How boorish; do you act this way when visiting other sectors?

spans.text: Oh my, is this how Greater Sanctifiers greet people? How boorish; do you act this way when visiting other sectors?

units.rawText: Of course not. Treating different entities in different ways is a sign of a functional IFF system. We are not Entropics who devour everything without distinction.
units.displayText: Of course not. Treating different entities in different ways is a sign of a functional IFF system. We are not Entropics who devour everything without distinction.

spans.text: Of course not. Treating different entities in different ways is a sign of a functional IFF system. We are not Entropics who devour everything without distinction.

units.rawText: Then what motivates you to act? Your superiors' orders?
units.displayText: Then what motivates you to act? Your superiors' orders?

spans.text: Then what motivates you to act? Your superiors' orders?

units.rawText: But then, the two of you are the pinnacles of the Sanctifiers, are you not?
units.displayText: But then, the two of you are the pinnacles of the Sanctifiers, are you not?

spans.text: But then, the two of you are the pinnacles of the Sanctifiers, are you not?

units.rawText: You know who we are?
units.displayText: You know who we are?

spans.text: You know who we are?

units.rawText: Hehe, I even knew you would come here.
units.displayText: Hehe, I even knew you would come here.

spans.text: Hehe, I even knew you would come here.

units.rawText: Dispense with your pointless bluffs. If you knew who we were and our objective, then you would have greeted us with the full force of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Dispense with your pointless bluffs. If you knew who we were and our objective, then you would have greeted us with the full force of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Dispense with your pointless bluffs. If you knew who we were and our objective, then you would have greeted us with the full force of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: Or are you saying Malkira is proud enough to believe a single High-Order Entropic can stop us?
units.displayText: Or are you saying Malkira is proud enough to believe a single High-Order Entropic can stop us?

spans.text: Or are you saying Malkira is proud enough to believe a single High-Order Entropic can stop us?

units.rawText: The newcomer shakes her head and curtsies.
units.displayText: The newcomer shakes her head and curtsies.

spans.text: The newcomer shakes her head and curtsies.

units.rawText: "High-Order Entropic" is such an impersonal form of address. Allow me to introduce myself. I am <color=#A066D3>Ptolemaea.</color>
units.displayText: "High-Order Entropic" is such an impersonal form of address. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Ptolemaea.

spans.text: "High-Order Entropic" is such an impersonal form of address. Allow me to introduce myself. I am
Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: Tartarus has no intention of stopping you. Rather, I bring well-intentioned advice.
units.displayText: Tartarus has no intention of stopping you. Rather, I bring well-intentioned advice.

spans.text: Tartarus has no intention of stopping you. Rather, I bring well-intentioned advice.

units.rawText: Well-intentioned advice?
units.displayText: Well-intentioned advice?

spans.text: Well-intentioned advice?

units.rawText: If this is a joke, it is hardly amusing.
units.displayText: If this is a joke, it is hardly amusing.

spans.text: If this is a joke, it is hardly amusing.

units.rawText: Why don't you think about my question?
units.displayText: Why don't you think about my question?

spans.text: Why don't you think about my question?

units.rawText: An enigmatic smile crosses the face of the azure High-Order Entropic.
units.displayText: An enigmatic smile crosses the face of the azure High-Order Entropic.

spans.text: An enigmatic smile crosses the face of the azure High-Order Entropic.

units.rawText: What motivates you to act? How did Tartarus know your objective?
units.displayText: What motivates you to act? How did Tartarus know your objective?

spans.text: What motivates you to act? How did Tartarus know your objective?

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers act upon orders. Their veracity is self-evident and there is no need to question them.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers act upon orders. Their veracity is self-evident and there is no need to question them.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers act upon orders. Their veracity is self-evident and there is no need to question them.

units.rawText: You probably saw us by chance while patrolling and wish to stall for time with pointless conjecture.
units.displayText: You probably saw us by chance while patrolling and wish to stall for time with pointless conjecture.

spans.text: You probably saw us by chance while patrolling and wish to stall for time with pointless conjecture.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Lady Malkira was right. You Sanctifiers cleave mindlessly to the dictates of the divine.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Lady Malkira was right. You Sanctifiers cleave mindlessly to the dictates of the divine.

spans.text: (Sigh) Lady Malkira was right. You Sanctifiers cleave mindlessly to the dictates of the divine.

units.rawText: Her Majesty has instructed me to give you some advice.
units.displayText: Her Majesty has instructed me to give you some advice.

spans.text: Her Majesty has instructed me to give you some advice.

units.rawText: The High-Order Entropic's eyes suddenly snap open, and the code flashing through her pupils resembles divine revelations.
units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic's eyes suddenly snap open, and the code flashing through her pupils resembles divine revelations.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic's eyes suddenly snap open, and the code flashing through her pupils resembles divine revelations.

units.rawText: Your actions violate the will of the gods. If you continue on this path, the gods will abandon their patronage of you and smite you with disaster.
units.displayText: Your actions violate the will of the gods. If you continue on this path, the gods will abandon their patronage of you and smite you with disaster.

spans.text: Your actions violate the will of the gods. If you continue on this path, the gods will abandon their patronage of you and smite you with disaster.

units.rawText: ...A crude provocation.
units.displayText: ...A crude provocation.

spans.text: ...A crude provocation.

units.rawText: You will not mock our faith.
units.displayText: You will not mock our faith.

spans.text: You will not mock our faith.

units.rawText: The two of them raise their hands again, but just as they are about to exterminate this unrepentant heretic, something strange happens.
units.displayText: The two of them raise their hands again, but just as they are about to exterminate this unrepentant heretic, something strange happens.

spans.text: The two of them raise their hands again, but just as they are about to exterminate this unrepentant heretic, something strange happens.

units.rawText: A sinister ripple erupts from the depths of Tartarus, sweeping across the entire sector in an instant. The sudden wave of intense discomfort makes the two of them freeze up.
units.displayText: A sinister ripple erupts from the depths of Tartarus, sweeping across the entire sector in an instant. The sudden wave of intense discomfort makes the two of them freeze up.

spans.text: A sinister ripple erupts from the depths of Tartarus, sweeping across the entire sector in an instant. The sudden wave of intense discomfort makes the two of them freeze up.

units.rawText: Rumblerumblerumble—
units.displayText: Rumblerumblerumble—

spans.text: Rumblerumblerumble—

units.rawText: It is immediately followed by a shift in the labyrinth. The High-Order Entropic looks into the distance and smiles.
units.displayText: It is immediately followed by a shift in the labyrinth. The High-Order Entropic looks into the distance and smiles.

spans.text: It is immediately followed by a shift in the labyrinth. The High-Order Entropic looks into the distance and smiles.

units.rawText: It seems the party has already begun.
units.displayText: It seems the party has already begun.

spans.text: It seems the party has already begun.

units.rawText: Eosphorus and Eos continue their attacks without hesitation, instantly chopping the High-Order Entropic's body into several pieces which collapse to the ground. There is something strange about the recoil they feel from their strikes.
units.displayText: Eosphorus and Eos continue their attacks without hesitation, instantly chopping the High-Order Entropic's body into several pieces which collapse to the ground. There is something strange about the recoil they feel from their strikes.

spans.text: Eosphorus and Eos continue their attacks without hesitation, instantly chopping the High-Order Entropic's body into several pieces which collapse to the ground. There is something strange about the recoil they feel from their strikes.

units.rawText: Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Eosphorus?

spans.text: Eosphorus?

units.rawText: You're not mistaken. The damage inflicted has deviated greatly from estimates.
units.displayText: You're not mistaken. The damage inflicted has deviated greatly from estimates.

spans.text: You're not mistaken. The damage inflicted has deviated greatly from estimates.

units.rawText: Who was affected, her or us?
units.displayText: Who was affected, her or us?

spans.text: Who was affected, her or us?

units.rawText: Eos glances at Eosphorus, who has suddenly gone silent, and she realizes what he means.
units.displayText: Eos glances at Eosphorus, who has suddenly gone silent, and she realizes what he means.
